name: Config error: storage_mode 'colunm' is not a valid value
description: storage_mode with a misspelled value must be rejected at config load rather than silently falling back to row storage (issue #187). Before the fix all three runtimes accepted it; the fallback DIRECTION had been aligned in #179 but the silence remained, so a typo produced a working engine whose memory and performance profile was the opposite of what was asked for. Message is byte-identical across the three runtimes.
